description: DC fast charging stations that do not meet NEVI but within 1-mile of a corridor March 2024 is a dataset listed in State of California open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by California Energy Commission. Locations of DC fast charging stations that do not meet NEVI power-level or port count requirements (as of March 2024) but are within 1-mile of a corridor. A data dictionary is available at. Coverage: California. The portal files it under the publisher California Energy Commission. Its tags are CAOpenData, California Energy Commission, California Natural Resources Agency, FTD, NEVI. It offers 6 resource(s) in ARCGIS GEOSERVICES REST API, CSV, GEOJSON, HTML, KML. The portal shows 2026-09-30 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-ca-portal.
